integrity.claim_scope: Source-specific counterexample and exact repair of the image criterion.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact operator inequalities and an explicit infinite-dimensional Parseval example; no numerical experiment is used as proof.

scientific_limitations: The correction assumes the commutation and controlled-frame hypotheses of the cited theorem.
No claim is made that the general surjective-image principle for ordinary frames is new.
An unindexed erratum, thesis remark, or informal author note could still contain the same source-specific observation.
title: Surjectivity, not invertibility, is the exact image criterion in a tensor controlled-frame theorem
